==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Johnson and I are trapped inside of a lava dome by a new enemy. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (The new enemy claimed to be the daughter of an ice elemental I slayed in the past. I call her Lava Goth. Lava Goth resembles a woman with an hourglass figure, long purple hair, a pale white face, thick black eyeliner, thick black lipstick, and a body made of red rocky hexagons glued together with glowing yellow lava. She wears purple fingerless gloves and matching purple lace up boots.)
I turn Johnson and I invisible, tricking the enemy into thinking we teleported away.
When the enemy drops the field, I knock them out with a sucker punch.
